**Finding: Compliant** (Section 19, ¶¶ 19.1–19.5) — no redline proposed.

Section 19 sits at or above the playbook's preferred position on every material term:

- **Services standard** — professional and workmanlike, by qualified personnel, to industry standards (19.1).
- **Conformance period** — 90 days for Deliverables running from delivery *or acceptance, whichever is later*, plus Hosted Services conforming for the whole subscription term, which is better for us than a fixed 12-month software window (19.2).
- **Compliance with law and no malicious code** — both present, with useful extras on functionality diminution and open-source contamination (19.3).
- **Remedy** — re-perform/repair/replace at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, and expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims (19.4). Not illusory.
- **Disclaimer** — mutual, confined to implied warranties, and expressly carved back so no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy (19.5). It does not swallow the express warranty.

Section 6 (acceptance) and Section 3 (service levels) are related but are handled under their own rules, so I have not double-flagged them here.
